fullPassage: When Steve Jobs was a college student, he did not know what he wanted to do in the future. He felt uncertain about how the normal classes he was required to take could help him figure out what to do with his life. He decided to start checking out things that seemed interesting to him. One day, he was walking around the college grounds and a poster caught his eye. The handwritten letters on every poster were elegant and beautiful. He became fascinated with the art of producing beautiful handwriting, also known as calligraphy, and decided to attend a calligraphy class. He gained an understanding of letter styles and learned to adjust the spacing between various combinations of letters. At that time, he did not expect that learning it would be useful or applicable to his life in the future. However, later when he developed his own computer operating system, he incorporated what he learned from that class into designing the system. As a result, he developed his own computer system with visually appealing letter styles. The artistic letters became a sensation at the time and are still widely used. His innovative incorporation of calligraphy into the world of technology, which started from his personal interest, has inspired many other corporations' computer system designs.

questions.passage: When Steve Jobs was a college student, he did not know what he wanted to do in the future. He felt (A)[uncertain / confident] about how the normal classes he was required to take could help him figure out what to do with his life. He decided to start checking out things that seemed (B)[interesting / boring] to him. One day, he was walking around the college grounds and a poster (C)[caught / lost] his eye.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 미래가 불확실(uncertain)했다. 흥미로운(interesting) 것들을 살펴보기 시작했다. 포스터가 그의 눈길을 끌었다(caught).
det.analysis:
✅ ① uncertain — interesting — caught: 원문 일치.
❌ ② confident(자신감 있는): uncertain의 반의어.
❌ ③ boring(지루한): interesting의 반의어.
❌ ④ lost(잃다): caught의 반의어. 'lost his eye'는 문맥 불가.
det.tip: uncertain(불확실한) ↔ confident(확신하는), catch one's eye = 눈길을 끌다.

questions.passage: The handwritten letters on every poster were (A)[elegant / crude] and beautiful. He became (B)[fascinated / bored] with the art of producing beautiful handwriting, also known as calligraphy, and decided to attend a calligraphy class. He gained an understanding of letter styles and learned to (C)[adjust / ignore] the spacing between various combinations of letters.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 글자가 우아하고(elegant) 아름다웠다. 캘리그래피에 매료되었다(fascinated). 간격을 조정하는(adjust) 것을 배웠다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ elegant — fascinated — adjust: 원문 일치.
❌ ① bored(지루한): fascinated의 반의어.
❌ ② crude(거친): elegant의 반의어.
❌ ③ ignore(무시하다): adjust의 반의어.
det.tip: elegant(우아한) ↔ crude(거친), fascinated(매료된) ↔ bored(지루한), adjust(조정하다) ↔ ignore(무시하다)

questions.passage: However, later when he developed his own computer operating system, he (A)[incorporated / excluded] what he learned from that class into designing the system. As a result, he developed his own computer system with visually (B)[appealing / repulsive] letter styles. The artistic letters became a (C)[sensation / failure] at the time and are still widely used.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 수업에서 배운 것을 시스템 설계에 반영했다(incorporated). 시각적으로 매력적인(appealing) 글자체를 개발했다. 당시 돌풍을 일으켰다(sensation).
det.analysis:
✅ ② incorporated — appealing — sensation: 원문 일치.
❌ ① excluded(배제하다): incorporated의 반의어.
❌ ③ repulsive(역겨운): appealing의 반의어.
❌ ④ failure(실패): sensation의 반의어.
det.tip: incorporate(반영/통합하다), visually appealing(시각적으로 매력적인), sensation(돌풍/선풍)

questions.passage: When Steve Jobs was a college student, he did not know what he wanted to do in the future. He felt ①<u>uncertain</u> about how the normal classes he was required to take could help him figure out what to do with his life. He decided to start checking out things that seemed interesting to him. One day, he was walking around the college grounds and a poster caught his eye. The handwritten letters on every poster were ②<u>elegant</u> and beautiful. He became ③<u>fascinated</u> with the art of producing beautiful handwriting, also known as calligraphy, and decided to ④<u>skip</u> a calligraphy class.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 의미가 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④skip(건너뛰다) → attend(참석하다): 캘리그래피에 매료되었으므로 수업을 건너뛴 것이 아니라 참석하기로 결정했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ skip → attend: fascinated(매료된) 후 수업 참석이 자연스러움.
❌ ① uncertain(불확실한): 미래를 몰랐으므로 적절.
❌ ② elegant(우아한): 글자가 아름다웠으므로 적절.
❌ ③ fascinated(매료된): 아름다운 손글씨에 매료되었으므로 적절.
det.tip: attend(참석하다) ↔ skip(건너뛰다/빼먹다). 맥락: 매료→수강 결정.

questions.passage: He gained an understanding of letter styles and learned to adjust the spacing between various combinations of letters. At that time, he did not expect that learning it would be ①<u>useful</u> or ②<u>applicable</u> to his life in the future. However, later when he developed his own computer operating system, he ③<u>incorporated</u> what he learned from that class into designing the system. As a result, he developed his own computer system with visually ④<u>dull</u> letter styles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 의미가 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④dull(칙칙한) → appealing(매력적인): 캘리그래피를 반영한 컴퓨터 시스템의 글자체는 '시각적으로 매력적'이어야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ dull → appealing: 캘리그래피 반영 결과가 '칙칙한'이면 모순.
❌ ① useful(유용한): 유용할 거라 예상 못했다는 맥락.
❌ ② applicable(적용 가능한): useful과 병렬.
❌ ③ incorporated(반영하다): 수업 내용을 시스템에 반영.
det.tip: visually appealing(시각적으로 매력적인) ↔ dull(칙칙한/지루한). 캘리그래피의 결과물은 아름다움.

questions.passage: However, later when he developed his own computer operating system, he incorporated what he learned from that class into designing the system. As a result, he developed his own computer system with visually appealing letter styles. The artistic letters became a sensation at the time and are still ①<u>widely</u> used. His ②<u>innovative</u> incorporation of calligraphy into the world of technology, which started from his ③<u>professional</u> interest, has ④<u>inspired</u> many other corporations' computer system designs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 의미가 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③professional(전문적인) → personal(개인적인): 캘리그래피는 Steve Jobs의 '개인적' 흥미에서 시작되었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ professional → personal: 원문 'started from his personal interest'. 직업적 관심이 아니라 개인적 흥미.
❌ ① widely(널리): 여전히 널리 쓰인다는 맥락 적절.
❌ ② innovative(혁신적인): 캘리그래피를 기술에 접목한 것이 혁신적이므로 적절.
❌ ④ inspired(영감을 주다): 다른 기업 디자인에 영감을 주었으므로 적절.
det.tip: personal(개인적인) ↔ professional(전문적인/직업적인). 문맥: 개인 관심사→기술 접목.

questions.passage: When Steve Jobs was a college student, he did not know what he wanted to do in the future. He felt uncertain about how the normal classes he was required to take could help him figure out what to do with his life. He decided to start checking out things that seemed interesting to him. One day, he was walking around the college grounds and a poster __________ his eye.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 포스터가 그의 눈길을 끌었다(caught his eye).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ caught: 'catch one's eye' = 눈길을 끌다. 관용표현.
❌ ① closed(닫다): 'closed his eye'는 눈을 감다.
❌ ② missed(놓치다): 'missed his eye'는 부자연스러운 표현.
❌ ④ hurt(다치게 하다): 'hurt his eye'는 눈을 다치게 하다.
det.tip: catch one's eye = 눈길을 끌다. 관용표현 암기.

questions.passage: One day, he was walking around the college grounds and a poster caught his eye. The handwritten letters on every poster were elegant and beautiful. He became fascinated with the art of producing beautiful handwriting, also known as calligraphy, and decided to attend a calligraphy class. He gained an understanding of letter styles and learned to __________ the spacing between various combinations of letters. At that time, he did not expect that learning it would be useful or applicable to his life in the future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글자들의 다양한 조합 간의 간격을 조정하는(adjust) 것을 배웠다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② adjust(조정하다): 글자 간격을 세밀하게 조정하는 것이 캘리그래피의 핵심.
❌ ① ignore(무시하다): 간격을 무시하면 배움의 의미가 없음.
❌ ③ enlarge(확대하다): 간격을 무조건 확대하는 것이 아님.
❌ ④ remove(제거하다): 간격을 제거하면 글자가 붙음.
det.tip: adjust(조정하다) = fine-tune = modify. 캘리그래피에서 글자 간격(spacing) 조정은 핵심 기술.

questions.passage: At that time, he did not expect that learning it would be useful or applicable to his life in the future. However, later when he developed his own computer operating system, he incorporated what he learned from that class into designing the system. As a result, he developed his own computer system with visually appealing letter styles. The artistic letters became a __________ at the time and are still widely used. His innovative incorporation of calligraphy into the world of technology has inspired many other corporations' computer system designs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 예술적인 글자들은 당시에 돌풍을 일으켰다(sensation).
det.analysis:
✅ ① sensation(선풍/돌풍): 성공적이었고 여전히 널리 쓰인다는 맥락.
❌ ② controversy(논란): 긍정적 결과와 어울리지 않음.
❌ ③ mystery(미스터리): 문맥 무관.
❌ ④ burden(부담): 성공적인 결과와 반대.
det.tip: sensation = 돌풍, 센세이션, 큰 화제. 'become a sensation' = 큰 화제가 되다.

questions.passage: The handwritten letters on every poster were <u>elegant</u> and beautiful. He became fascinated with the art of producing beautiful handwriting, also known as calligraphy.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 elegant의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 포스터의 손글씨가 우아하고(elegant) 아름다웠다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ graceful(우아한): elegant과 동의어.
❌ ① ugly(추한): elegant의 반의어.
❌ ② rough(거친): elegant의 반의어.
❌ ③ plain(평범한): elegant의 반의어.
det.tip: elegant = graceful = refined = sophisticated (우아한, 세련된).

questions.passage: His innovative incorporation of calligraphy into the world of technology, which started from his personal interest, has <u>inspired</u> many other corporations' computer system designs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 inspired의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 다른 기업들의 컴퓨터 시스템 디자인에 영감을 주었다(inspired).
det.analysis:
✅ ② influenced(영향을 미치다): inspired와 동의어. 긍정적 영향.
❌ ① discouraged(낙담시키다): inspired의 반의어.
❌ ③ prevented(방해하다): inspired의 반의어.
❌ ④ confused(혼란시키다): inspired와 무관.
det.tip: inspire = influence = motivate (영감을 주다, 영향을 미치다).

questions.passage: He felt uncertain about how the normal classes he was required to take could help him <u>figure out</u> what to do with his life. He decided to start checking out things that seemed interesting to him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 figure out의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 삶에서 무엇을 할지 알아내다(figure out).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ determine(결정하다/알아내다): figure out과 동의어.
❌ ① calculate(계산하다): 수치 계산의 뉘앙스.
❌ ② imagine(상상하다): 알아내기와 다름.
❌ ④ create(만들다): 알아내기와 다름.
det.tip: figure out = determine = find out = work out (알아내다, 파악하다).

questions.passage: At that time, he did not expect that learning it would be <u>useful</u> or applicable to his life in the future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 useful의 의미와 가장 반대되는 것은?

det.korean: 배우는 것이 유용(useful)할 거라 예상 못했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① worthless(쓸모없는): useful의 반의어.
❌ ② helpful(도움이 되는): useful과 동의어.
❌ ③ practical(실용적인): useful과 유사어.
❌ ④ beneficial(유익한): useful과 동의어.
det.tip: useful = helpful = practical ↔ worthless = useless = futile.

questions.passage: His <u>innovative</u> incorporation of calligraphy into the world of technology has inspired many other corporations' computer system designs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 innovative의 의미와 가장 반대되는 것은?

det.korean: 캘리그래피를 기술에 혁신적으로(innovative) 접목시킨 일.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ conventional(전통적인/관습적인): innovative의 반의어.
❌ ① creative(창의적인): innovative와 동의어.
❌ ② original(독창적인): innovative와 동의어.
❌ ③ groundbreaking(획기적인): innovative와 동의어.
det.tip: innovative = creative = original ↔ conventional = traditional = ordinary.

questions.passage:
(A) He gained an understanding of letter <u>styles</u> and learned to adjust the spacing between various combinations of letters.

(B) The new manager's leadership <u>style</u> emphasizes collaboration and open communication among team members.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 style(s)의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 글자 서체(letter styles)에 대한 이해. (B) 리더십 방식(leadership style).
det.analysis:
✅ ① 서체/양식 — 방식: (A)는 글자의 시각적 양식, (B)는 행동/접근 방식.
❌ ② 의미 뒤바뀜.
❌ ③ (A)는 '방식'이 아니라 '서체'.
❌ ④ (B)는 '서체'가 아니라 '방식'.
det.tip: style 다의어: ① 양식/서체(visual style) ② 방식(manner/approach) ③ 스타일/유행(fashion).

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the art of producing beautiful handwriting using a special pen or brush"

det.korean: 특별한 펜이나 붓을 사용하여 아름다운 손글씨를 만드는 기술 = 캘리그래피(calligraphy)
det.analysis:
✅ ② calligraphy(캘리그래피): 아름다운 손글씨 기술.
❌ ① typography(타이포그래피): 활자 디자인/인쇄 기술.
❌ ③ photography(사진술): 사진 촬영 기술.
❌ ④ biography(전기): 인물의 생애를 다룬 글.
det.tip: calli-(아름다운) + graphy(쓰기) = calligraphy. 본문에서 'also known as calligraphy'로 정의.

questions.passage: He felt uncertain about how the normal classes he was required to take could help him figure out what to do with his life. He decided to start __________ (check) out things that seemed interesting to him.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 흥미로운 것들을 살펴보기(checking out) 시작하기로 했다.
det.analysis: start + V-ing: '~하기 시작하다'. check → checking. start 뒤에 동명사 또는 to부정사 가능.
det.tip: start + V-ing / to V: 두 형태 모두 가능. 여기서는 원문이 checking이므로 동명사.

questions.passage: The artistic letters became a sensation at the time and are still widely used. His innovative __________ (incorporate) of calligraphy into the world of technology has inspired many other corporations' computer system designs.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 캘리그래피를 기술 세계에 혁신적으로 접목시킨 일(incorporation).
det.analysis: incorporate(v. 반영하다/통합하다) → incorporation(n. 통합/접목). 형용사 innovative 뒤에 명사가 필요.
det.tip: incorporate(v.) → incorporation(n.). 'His innovative incorporation' = 형용사+명사 구조. 동사→명사 변환에 주의.

questions.passage: When Steve Jobs was a college student, he did not know what he wanted to do in the future. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 포스터가 그의 눈길을 끌었다(caught his eye).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ caught his eye: 흥미로운 것을 찾던 중 포스터가 눈에 띈 것.
❌ ① fell down(떨어졌다): 포스터가 떨어지는 것은 관심을 끌지 못함.
❌ ② disappeared(사라졌다): 문맥 불일치.
❌ ④ blocked his way(길을 막았다): 포스터가 길을 막는 것은 부자연스러움.
det.tip: catch one's eye = attract one's attention = 눈길을 끌다.

questions.passage: He gained an understanding of letter styles and learned to adjust the spacing between various combinations of letters. At that time, he did not expect that learning it would be useful or applicable to his life in the future. However, later when he developed his own computer operating system, he __________ what he learned from that class into designing the system. As a result, he developed his own computer system with visually appealing letter styles. The artistic letters became a sensation at the time and are still widely used.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수업에서 배운 것을 시스템 설계에 반영했다(incorporated).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ incorporated(반영하다/통합하다): However 역접 후, 예상 못한 활용. 캘리그래피를 컴퓨터 디자인에 반영.
❌ ① removed(제거하다): 배운 것을 제거하면 결과와 모순.
❌ ② abandoned(버리다): 배운 것을 버리면 결과 없음.
❌ ③ ignored(무시하다): 무시하면 시스템에 반영 불가.
det.tip: incorporate = include = integrate (통합하다/반영하다). 'incorporate A into B' = A를 B에 반영하다.
